purpose: Register candidate satellite-derived feature and hyperspectral sources without promoting them to authoritative terrain, observations, forecasts, or engineering conclusions.

sources.coveragePolicy: Coverage varies by year. 2023-2025 are reported as global at release; 2017-2022 have selected-country coverage. Verify tile/year availability and provenance for each requested AOI before use.
provenanceRequirements: reference year and exact tile identifier
native CRS, transform, dimensions, nodata, and content checksum
label provenance and held-out validation metrics for any downstream classifier

license.name: OlmoEarth Artifact License
license.restrictedUseSummary: License restricts military/defense-related uses and certain extractive activities, including planning or facilitating extraction of oil, natural gas, and minerals and deforestation. Obtain legal/compliance review for the intended TSM use and all derivative distribution.

allowedInitialUses: research classifier prototyping using independently sourced labels
prohibitedUses: direct flood depth, water-surface elevation, or hydraulic-boundary claims
regulatory determinations without independent authoritative evidence
deployment before license and intended-use review
limitations: Embeddings are learned features, not direct physical measurements.
Global product claims do not establish AOI-specific coverage or suitability.
Downstream maps require representative labels, held-out spatial validation, uncertainty reporting, and human review.

sources.product: Tanager hyperspectral Level 1C and Level 2A products

products.operationalUse: research-only until calibration and product suitability are validated
research-only until atmospheric correction, calibration, and product suitability are validated

sources.accessPolicy: NASA announced an evaluation task order. This does not establish that all Tanager data is public or that TSM has API credentials. Verify contract/access eligibility, product availability, terms, API behavior, and AOI coverage before attempting ingestion.
provenanceRequirements: provider scene/product ID and acquisition time
spectral band centers, widths, units, and calibration metadata
atmospheric-correction and quality flags where applicable
native CRS, geotransform, nodata, QA mask, and content checksum
license/access terms, retrieval time, and API request lineage
allowedInitialUses: research evaluation of vegetation, surface-material, water-quality-related, and other environmental spectral indicators where product and validation support the question
prohibitedUses: assume public access or invent credentials
treat announcement coverage as guaranteed TSM AOI coverage
infer flood depth, hydraulic conveyance, or ground elevation from spectral reflectance alone
promote unvalidated derived classifications to authoritative engineering evidence
limitations: NASA's announced evaluation is not proof of operational suitability for TSM.
Spectral signatures require domain-specific calibration, atmospheric correction, ground truth, and uncertainty assessment.
The exact data-access rights and available AOI coverage must be confirmed at integration time.
